$comment: CC BY 4.0 arXiv papers used as sample content. The setup script re-verifies each licence through the arXiv OAI-PMH metadata and only uploads Creative Commons Attribution papers. The PDFs are committed in data/papers (see ATTRIBUTION.md) and downloaded again only if missing.

research.$containerComment: Index every document library of the root site AND its subsites (LLM Lab). The Sites.Selected grant is on the site collection, so it covers subsites too.

Archive.title: ACL Demo - Research (Archive library)
Archive.description: A second document library in the Research root site. Only indexed when the container is allSiteLibraries (or useQuery includeLibrary=...), never with defaultSiteLibrary.

Notes.access: Inherits site permissions: All staff group (Read). Lives in the second library 'Archive', not in 'Documents'.

llmlab.title: ACL Demo - LLM Lab
llmlab.description: Subsite of Research with unique permissions: Quantum team group + Bob (Read). Indexed through the Research data source (includeSubsites=true).

Papers.access: Inherits the subsite's unique permissions: Quantum team Entra group (Alice) and Bob (direct user), Read.
